correctness.rationale: Both inverse branches and their Jacobians are calculated explicitly; normalized h=2(1-x) satisfies Ph=h. The conditional image density integrates exactly to 4u(t)^2, where t is the (n-1)-th left-branch inverse threshold. Thus every return tail is 4a_n². The recurrence gives a telescoping mean 4 and asymptotics a_n~2/n, yielding tail constant 16, point-mass constant 32, and the s=2 moment cutoff. All endpoints are measure-zero; the checker tested rational identities but is not the proof.
